ko.title: 픽업 포지션과 하모닉 샘플링 — 정규화된 현 좌표에서 프렛별 공간 샘플링까지
ko.excerpt: 전기 기타·베이스의 magnetic pickup position을 “bridge = bright / neck = warm” 같은 tone adjective로만 설명하지 않고, vibrating string의 특정 spatial coordinate를 읽는 sampling geometry로 정의한다. A01에서 확립한 signal chain 가운데 이번 회차는 pickup-coordinate sampling을 분리하되, ideal string의 mode shape factor와 실제 induced voltage를 동일시하지 않는다. Point-sensor 위치계수, fret 변화에 따른 normalized coordinate, plucking-point excitation, finite sensing kernel, multi-pickup spatial mixing, magnetic-field geometry와 real-string effects를 문헌으로 검증하고, RavenForge ASKR·EMBLA 및 향후 3PU layout에서 사용할 공통 coordinate model과 C01 measurement protocol을 구축한다. 특정 pickup 좌표나 sensing width를 아직 최적값으로 확정하지 않는다.

en.title: Pickup Position and Harmonic Sampling — From normalized string coordinates to fret-dependent spatial sampling
en.excerpt: Rather than describing magnetic pickup position on electric guitars and basses only through tone adjectives such as “bridge = bright / neck = warm,” this log defines it as sampling geometry that reads a specific spatial coordinate of the vibrating string. Within the signal chain established in A01, this entry isolates pickup-coordinate sampling while explicitly separating the ideal string mode-shape factor from actual induced voltage. Literature is used to verify point-sensor position factors, fret-dependent normalized coordinates, plucking-point excitation, finite sensing kernels, multi-pickup spatial mixing, magnetic-field geometry, and real-string effects. The goal is to establish a common coordinate model and C01 measurement protocol for RavenForge ASKR, EMBLA, and future 3PU layouts. No pickup coordinate or sensing width is declared optimal at this stage.

de.title: Pickup-Position und harmonische Abtastung — Von normierten Saitenkoordinaten zur bundabhängigen räumlichen Abtastung
de.excerpt: Die Position eines magnetischen Pickups bei E-Gitarre und Bass wird nicht nur über Klangadjektive wie „Bridge = hell / Neck = warm“ beschrieben, sondern als Abtastgeometrie definiert, die eine bestimmte räumliche Koordinate der schwingenden Saite erfasst. Innerhalb der in A01 etablierten Signalkette isoliert dieser Eintrag die Pickup-Koordinatenabtastung und trennt den Modenformfaktor der idealen Saite ausdrücklich von der real induzierten Spannung. Literatur dient zur Verifikation von Punktsensor-Positionsfaktoren, bundabhängigen normierten Koordinaten, Anschlagpunktanregung, endlichen Sensitivitätskernen, räumlicher Multi-Pickup-Mischung, Magnetfeldgeometrie und Effekten realer Saiten. Ziel ist ein gemeinsames Koordinatenmodell und C01-Messprotokoll für RavenForge ASKR, EMBLA und zukünftige 3PU-Layouts. In dieser Phase wird weder eine Pickup-Koordinate noch eine Sensitivitätsbreite als optimal festgelegt.
